name: co-op
description: A second player reviews before the PR: gh pr create waits for a second-model review of the branch diff, and a failing review with a high finding blocks it.

model.title: Reviewer model
model.description: The model that reviews the diff. Empty picks another tier than the session's model (opus reviews sonnet's work, sonnet reviews opus's and haiku's), else the session's model.

command.title: Reviewer command
command.description: Optional. A command line run instead of the model, with the review prompt and diff on stdin; its stdout must hold the same JSON verdict. It sends your diff wherever that command sends it.

maxDiffKb.title: Diff limit (KB)
maxDiffKb.description: The diff is cut at a line boundary below this many kilobytes before review, and the review says so.

timeoutSeconds.title: Review time limit (seconds)
timeoutSeconds.description: How long the reviewer may take. Past it the review counts as unreadable and the PR is let through with a toast.
